query:
SELECT id, city, state, 
  JSON_EXTRACT(report_data, '$.revenue_estimate.annual_revenue') as annual_revenue,
  JSON_EXTRACT(report_data, '$.revenue_estimate.average_daily_rate') as adr,
  JSON_EXTRACT(report_data, '$.revenue_estimate.occupancy_rate') as occupancy,
  JSON_EXTRACT(report_data, '$.comp_median_adjustment') as comp_adjustment
FROM shared_reports 
WHERE id = '4g6g9mo4mlpnmcva'
